need.role: Discover a complete reusable light-combat or training-dummy component before assigning replacement implementation, with priority on working attack sequencing, server authority, humanoid animation, feedback, and embedded media.
need.constraints: Inspect all scripts, remotes, rig assumptions, animation references, sound references, dependencies, and ownership rules. Candidate must be compatible with a one-player R15 training arena, contain no numeric require IDs or arbitrary HTTP execution, and not force PvP, persistence, monetization, matchmaking, weapons, or a large world. Preserve useful verified behavior and media. Unsupported source, rig, or serialization import must be reported as a capability gap rather than treated as permission to rebuild the component.

intent.experienceRole: Potentially supplies the central Strike Lab loop while minimizing replacement of already working Marketplace combat behavior.
intent.interaction: The player presses or taps Light Attack to perform a three-step combo against a stationary humanoid dummy; each step visibly passes through windup, contact, and recovery, while authoritative validation determines hit or miss at contact.
reusableFeatures: Server-authoritative attack timing and range checks
Attack phase animations or animation references
Per-swing hit deduplication and recovery gating
Dummy health, reset, or training-counter behavior
Embedded impact audio and visible hit/miss feedback

need.role: Acquire a Model containing compatible, auditable humanoid animation assets for all three light attacks because standalone Animation retrieval is not supported by the adapter and static or tween-only attacks do not satisfy the request.
need.constraints: Must contain three usable R15 humanoid attack animations or a coherent three-hit combo with clearly observable windup, contact, and recovery. Inspect animation ownership, loading permissions, rig compatibility, marker timing, scripts, and dependencies. Actual playback on the player rig must be verified natively. Do not invent animation IDs, convert unsupported imports into procedural animation, or accept a static dummy damage script.

intent.experienceRole: Provides the readable fighting-game motion that teaches timing and makes each combo step feel distinct rather than reducing the lab to invisible damage calls.
intent.interaction: A discrete desktop or touch press starts the current combo animation; damage eligibility occurs once at its contact phase, and input remains gated through recovery.

need.role: Find a compatible humanoid training dummy rig that can visibly receive strikes, expose reliable health state, reset cleanly, and reuse any safe working reactions or training behavior discovered with it.
need.constraints: Prefer a compact R15 humanoid rig with connected unanchored body parts, Humanoid, Animator, stable root placement, and no unrelated map or combat systems. Inspect scripts, joints, collision behavior, animation references, sounds, and reset behavior. It must fit the Strike Lab mat and remain stationary without becoming a non-humanoid static prop. A retained complete combat component may satisfy this need after inspection.

intent.experienceRole: Acts as the readable target and health-bearing practice opponent for repeated combo, miss, defeat, and reset exercises.
intent.interaction: The player approaches and attacks; accepted contact reduces its health and triggers visible feedback, defeat enters a short KO state, and automatic or manual reset restores the practice target.
reusableFeatures: Existing training UI or sounds worth preserving

need.role: Supply the mandatory synchronized strike-impact sound if a retained complete component does not already provide an acceptable captured sound; included component audio still requires the same loading, playback, and listening verification.
need.constraints: Use a concise non-musical fighting-game body-impact sound appropriate for repeated light strikes. Preserve provenance and verify loading, spatial playback at the dummy, audibility, and synchronization with each accepted contact. It must not play for a miss, rejected request, held input, duplicate contact, or recovery spam. No generated, built-in, procedural, placeholder, or invented-ID fallback is allowed.

intent.experienceRole: Confirms the exact authoritative contact moment and reinforces the distinction between an accepted hit and a whiff.
intent.interaction: The sound plays once at the dummy when the server accepts a strike at contact; rejected attacks and misses remain silent with respect to impact audio.
reusableFeatures: Suitable repetition without a long tail

tasks.title: Search Marketplace for a complete training-combat component, then compatible rig, contained combo animations, and captured or standalone impact audio; record provenance and capability gaps.

Audit candidate scripts, hierarchy, remotes, rigs, animation permissions and markers, sound references, dependencies, and behavior; retain useful verified content and establish the minimal integration ownership only after inspection.
Construct the compact Strike Lab spawn, mat, target mark, boundaries, lighting, and clean approach/range-testing space inside the Workspace namespace.
Place and configure the inspected humanoid dummy, authoritative 100-health state, stationary reactions, targetability, defeat gating, and reset-safe transform without replacing verified rig behavior.

Integrate or complete the server-owned three-step state machine, phase timing, range and facing validation, per-swing tokens, damage values, recovery/rate gates, and reset cancellation around retained interfaces.

Bind verified playing combo animations and discrete desktop/touch input to the authoritative attack flow, preserving visible windup, contact, recovery, continuation timeout, and recovery-disabled states.
Synchronize retained or sourced impact audio and distinct hit/miss visual feedback with the authoritative contact result, ensuring rejected swings create no accepted feedback.
Create or adapt the responsive health, accepted-hit, combo-readiness, KO, control-hint, and reset presentation using authoritative replicated state and separate desktop/touch controls.

Handle character respawn and player departure by rebinding the current humanoid and Animator once, canceling queued attacks, cleaning feedback and connections, and preventing duplicate dummy or HUD state.

Run protected native verification for required hierarchy, full combo animation and exact damage/counting, synchronized audible impacts, misses, held input, recovery spam, defeat, automatic/manual reset, respawn, and desktop/touch controls; report every blocked capability honestly.
